rules.description: S1 must have a response.
S1 must contain one of the documented interviewer response codes.
S2 must have a response.
S2 must contain a documented gender response code.
S3 must have a response.
S3 must contain a documented age-band code.
Respondents coded under 18 must be screened out.
S3.5 must have a response.
S3.5 must contain a documented living-arrangement code.
S4 is required for respondents who picked up items from the lamb bay.
S4 must contain a documented purchase-frequency code when applicable.
Q1.1 must have a response.
Q1.1 selections must use documented item codes.
Q1.1 is a multiple-response item selection.
Q1.2 is required when a lamb cut was selected in Q1.1.
Q1.2 must contain a documented occasion code when applicable.
Q1.3WHAT is required when ingredients but no lamb cut were selected.
Q1.3WHAT must contain documented recipe codes when applicable.
Q1.3WHAT is documented as a multiple-response recipe question.
Q1.4 is required when Q1.1 excludes lamb-cut codes 1–4.
Q1.4 must contain a documented reason code when applicable.
Q1.5 must have a response.
Q1.5 selections must use documented reason codes.
Q1.5 is documented as a multiple-response reasons question.
Q1.6 must have a response.
Q1.6 must contain a documented appeal code.
Q1.7 is required for respondents who looked at but did not pick up items.
Q1.7 must contain a documented response code when applicable.
Q2.1 must have a response.
Q2.1 must contain a documented attraction code.
Q2.2 is required for respondents who did not look at the bay.
Q2.2 selections must use documented reason codes when applicable.
Q2.2 permits no more than three selected reasons.
Q2.2 is a multiple-response reasons question.
Q3.1 must have a response.
Q3.1 must contain a documented awareness code.
Q3.2 must have a response.
Q3.2 selections must use documented concept-appeal codes.
Q3.2 is documented as a multiple-response concept-appeal question.
Q3.3 must have a response for all respondents.
Q3.3 selections must use documented dislike codes.
Q3.3 is documented as a multiple-response dislike question.
Q4.1 must be scored from 1 to 10.
Q4.2 must be scored from 1 to 10.
Q4.3 recipe scores must be from 1 to 10.
Q4.4 must be scored from 1 to 10.
Q4.4A is an open-ended comment response.
Q4.5 must be scored from 1 to 10.
Q4.5A is an open-ended comment response.
Q4.6 must have a response.
Q4.6 must contain a documented future-purchase likelihood code.
Response must be a value from 1 to 10 on the stated scale.
Validate the open-ended response as text input.

warnings: Q4.3 describes four recipe ratings but supplies only the base variable Q4.3; validation uses that supplied base variable without inventing item-level variables.
Open-text options in Q1.3WHAT, Q1.4, Q1.5, Q2.1, Q2.2, Q3.2, and Q3.3 do not have separate supplied text variables, so no separate open-text consistency rules were added.
